entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕黎：疑为“黎明”之义（拂晓、天明），据 M 栏尾附西语“al amanecer”；L 栏词头与之不合，无法定夺
entries.en: uncertain: 黎 likely 'daybreak, dawn' (M column ends with the Spanish gloss 'al amanecer'); the Spanish headword 'Juuentud que abisona' (youth?) conflicts — not determined
entries.notes: L/H/M 三栏互证失败：L 栏 'Juuentud q̃ abisona' 与黎＋al amanecer 抵牾，仅按 M 栏西语释语暂拟“黎明”义。

entries.en: to decide, judge (a case); to cut off, sever

entries.zh: 问：审问、讯问（案情）；问罪、治罪
entries.en: to interrogate, examine (a case); to call to account, condemn

entries.zh: 判是非：评判是非曲直、辨明真假
entries.en: to judge right and wrong; to determine whether a thing is true or false
to judge and decide; to determine
to judge, hold trial; to pass sentence
to judge rightly and decide firmly; resolution

entries.notes: M 栏后半 [残] 且两处 T99，L 栏亦残乱（'juzgar el cora…'），仅 H 栏“體”可辨，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕字面“过我心便”（疑为“合我心便”＝合乎我心即可之类短语），语义无法定夺
entries.en: uncertain: literal 過我心便 ('if it suits my heart, then fine'?) — sense not determined
entries.notes: L 栏 'juzgar por mi ael otro' 与 H/M 栏短语未能对上，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕字面“过你心”，语义无法定夺
entries.en: uncertain: literal 過你心 ('passes your heart'?) — sense not determined
entries.notes: L 栏 'juzgar desto-' 与 H/M 栏短语未能对上，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 推己（及人）：以己度人、设身处地为他人着想
entries.en: to judge another by oneself; to put oneself in another's place (推己及人)
entries.notes: H 栏标注 [疑:已/己]，按成语“推己及人”与 M 栏读音 gúy 定为“己”。

entries.zh: 将心比心：设身处地、以己度人
entries.en: to put oneself in another's place; to judge another by oneself
entries.notes: 仅“比”字声调号 T99 污损，四栏文字与语义均清晰，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 断然判定他人：一口咬定“他是……”（字面“力叫伊是”，第二字存疑）
entries.en: to pronounce categorically on another, 'to insist/declare that he is…' (juzgar determinadamente)
entries.notes: H 栏标注 [疑:叫/吐]，M 栏音写 gŭioy 与两候选皆未尽合；依 L 栏 'determinadamente' 定“断然判定”义。
M 栏第二音写标注 [疑:sien/fien] 未解，据 L 栏 lavar 与 H 栏“洗”定“洗”义。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕H 栏字面“稠”（浓稠、稠密），与 L 栏 labar（洗）不合，语义无法定夺
entries.en: uncertain: literal 稠 'thick, dense' — irreconcilable with headword 'labar' (to wash); not determined
entries.notes: 三栏不互证且有 [疑:te/He]，疑“稠”为形近字（如“疇”）之误认，待查原件。

entries.en: to pour (water) over, drench; to irrigate
entries.notes: M 栏音写（sèychoj…to guís）未能尽解，释义依 L 栏 lavar 与 H 栏“灌”（以水浇灌）两栏。
